description: This file defines a Go struct for configuring Kubernetes ReplicationController specifications declaratively, including methods for building and chaining configuration options.

classes.name: ReplicationControllerSpecApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration for Kubernetes ReplicationControllerSpec, with fields for replicas, minReadySeconds, selector, and template.

methods.name: WithReplicas
methods.description: Sets the number of desired replicas in the configuration.

methods.name: WithMinReadySeconds
methods.description: Sets the minimum seconds for pod readiness.

methods.name: WithSelector
methods.description: Sets the label selector map for the configuration.
